capabilities: embed precise text ranges from markdown files
combine multiple ranges into one embed
display embeds inline with surrounding text
show source author and title on embeds
copy an embed reference to the clipboard from a selection
extras: README documents limitations: copy from preview mode fails for content like MathJax, nested quoth embeds are unsupported, and embeds are display-only (checkbox state cannot be updated). Some code block fields (file, heading, block) are deprecated in favor of path.
intentEvidence: allows embedding from other markdown files with greater flexibility than the standard embed syntax
problem: Obsidian's standard embed syntax can only include whole blocks or sections, not arbitrary sub-selections or inline embeds with source attribution.
summary: Flexible embed plugin that embeds precise selections, multiple ranges, or inline snippets from other markdown files, optionally with author and title.
